title: Uneed: Launch. Get seen. Grow.
summary: A 15 s three-word launch promo for a product-launch platform. A lightning bolt strikes a glowing ring on dark brown, flashes into warm orange, 'Launch' slams in as heavy serif with a bolt glyph, the camera flies through the letters into a leaderboard where 'Your product' climbs to #1 as avatar cursors upvote it, then a dark growth chart traces with a glowing comet, ending on a clean logo lockup. Warm, cinematic, playful but tight.
fit_reason: Three-word headline structure and 'zoom through the word into the UI' are perfect for a SaaSSuite launch sting; the warm orange palette and lightning are on-trend but would need recolouring to navy/blue.

palette.mood: warm orange + cream with a dark espresso contrast act; glow and light grain

typography.display: chunky high-contrast serif display (Cooper/Recoleta-like, very heavy) for the three hero words; rounded geometric sans for UI and wordmark
typography.case: sentence, each word ends with an orange full stop
typography.size_behaviour: huge centred for 'Launch' (~20% frame height), then mid-size left column headline ('Get seen.', 'Grow.') beside UI
typography.notes: Tiny tracked uppercase eyebrow labels in orange with a dot: '• LAUNCH DAY', '• AFTER LAUNCH'. Each headline ends with a coloured period.

text_animation: letters rise from bottom with slight per-letter stagger and motion blur (2.0 s shows the 'L' stem rising first)
bolt icon flies in and lands next to the word with a small ripple ring
camera dolly through the counter of the letters (3.3 s) into the next scene
end tagline builds word-by-word: 'Launch.' then 'Get seen.' then 'Grow.' (each fades from grey to dark)
motion: lightning strike + glowing ring intro with sparks
zoom-through on the giant word, letters turn white as camera passes them
leaderboard card rows reorder: 'Your product' slides up from #5 to #1 with count ticking
multi-colour named cursors (Jules, Zoe, Sam, Omar, Mika) swarm the upvote button with '+1' particles
comet with orange trail draws an upward growth line with a glowing head; KPI badges count (82,583 -> 85,000, 88K -> 90K)
logo assembles from bolt + two squares + U-shape over concentric orange rings
transitions: white flash/light bloom from dark into orange
organic blob wipe (cream shape sweeps over orange)
sticker-like 'Daily winner 1st' badge slam then fade to black
dark to white with concentric ring ripple for logo
graphic_elements: leaderboard list cards with rounded squares app icons
glowing area chart with dotted gridline and month axis
ui_treatment: rebuilt UI: simplified leaderboard cards floating in space with slight 3D tilt on entry, then flat; chart rebuilt on dark

sound.music: punchy cinematic electronic, likely ~120 bpm with impacts
sound.sfx: thunder crack, whooshes on zoom-through, pops on cursor clicks
sound.sync: word slams and scene changes land on hits

signature_moves: one-word heavy serif title per act ending with a coloured full stop
fly-through the giant word into the product UI
multiplayer named cursors clicking upvote with +1 particles
glowing comet tracing a growth chart on dark

best_segments.what: Flash to orange, 'Launch' rises in heavy serif with bolt, camera zooms through the letters into UI
Leaderboard: 'Your product' climbs to #1 while named cursors swarm upvote
Dark act: comet draws a growth chart, KPI badges count up beside 'Grow.'
Logo assembles over rings, three-word tagline builds

recreate.how: Remotion or HTML+GSAP. SVG text with per-letter y stagger; scale the word 1 -> 40x around a letter counter for the fly-through; leaderboard rows via FLIP reorder; chart as SVG path with stroke-dashoffset + radial-glow div following the path head; lightning can be a stock overlay.
recreate.prompt: Warm orange #eb9147 canvas with falling light streaks; heavy serif 'Launch.' rises letter by letter, camera flies through the letters into a cream leaderboard where 'Your product' climbs to #1 under a swarm of named cursors; cut to espresso #160f0d where a glowing comet draws a growth chart beside 'Grow.'; end on logo over concentric rings.
